faqs.q: What is SiteFlow client invoicing software for construction?
faqs.a: It connects BOQ-linked activity scheduling, daily progress recording, and RA bill generation from verified executed quantities, so invoices are backed by field data and disputes are minimized.

faqs.q: How does SiteFlow generate BOQ-linked client invoices?
faqs.a: Client invoices are generated directly from the BOQ items linked to the project and the executed quantities recorded against those items through daily site progress tracking.

faqs.q: Does SiteFlow support milestone-based billing for interior firms?
faqs.a: Yes. Interior and fit-out firms can invoice on contractor-stated completion percentages or specific milestones that have passed certification.
